summary: Oceaneering International filed an 8-K announcing a private placement of $500M 6.875% Senior Notes due 2034, entered via a purchase agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities as representative of initial purchasers. The offering, exempt under Rule 144A and Regulation S, is expected to close July 6, 2026. Net proceeds, together with cash on hand, will fund the purchase of the 2028 Notes in a previously announced tender offer, representing a capital return via deleveraging/refinancing. Remaining proceeds may be used for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment or repurchase. Watch for tender offer results and interest rate environment impact.
